briefing_zh:
本周AI研究领域的最大亮点是**AREX**的发布——一个具备递归自我改进能力的深度研究Agent，以141票高居HuggingFace热榜榜首。AREX的核心创新在于「发现-验证不对称」：传统Agent只会更长时间地搜索，而AREX通过对中间约束进行逐项验证、递归改进当前答案，使研究质量呈指数级提升。与此同时，**Agentic Context Management**论文深入剖析了生产环境Agent最常见的失败模式——不是推理能力不足，而是上下文管理崩溃。该论文提出将记忆和成本问题视为生命周期与架构问题，为Agent工程师提供了清晰的系统设计框架。

在Agent框架工程领域，**NVIDIA OO Agents (NOOA)**提出了一种耳目一新的设计哲学：agent就是Python对象，方法就是action，字段就是状态。这种面向对象的设计消除了prompt模板、工具schema、回调代码之间的割裂，将复杂度大幅降低。与之呼应的是GitHub新星**makecindy/cindy**，一个「说完即做」的开源AI agent，以711星迅速获得社区认可。**krakonjac300-pixel/podcast-shorts-factory**则展示了多Agent协作的商业化潜力——10个协作Agent将长播客转化为短视频内容，fork比率（29）远高于同期项目，说明社区真实在使用。

在多模态与视频生成方向，**SANA-Video 2.0**以单GPU生成720p高质量视频为目标，5B/14B两种规模均采用混合线性注意力架构，在保持视频质量的同时显著降低了长序列的计算开销。此外**LeAct**提出了一个富有洞察力的训练范式：从专家系统（游戏引擎、定理证明器等）的动作中学习推理，让模型「学会推理」而不仅是「学会结果」。**Scaling Agentic RL**（Prime Intellect）则一次性开放了365,000+个环境，覆盖SWE、终端和搜索任务，为agentic RL的大规模训练扫清了数据障碍。
briefing_en:
The standout of this week's AI research is **AREX**, a recursively self-improving deep research agent that topped HuggingFace's daily chart with 141 votes. AREX exploits a discovery-verification asymmetry: rather than simply searching longer, it recursively improves its current answer through constraint-wise verification, delivering exponential gains in research quality. Equally impactful is the **Agentic Context Management** paper, which argues that production agent failures stem not from poor reasoning but from context collapse — and frames memory and cost as lifecycle and architecture problems, giving engineers a clear system design vocabulary.

On the agent framework engineering front, **NVIDIA OO Agents (NOOA)** proposes a refreshingly clean philosophy: an agent is a Python object, its methods are actions, its fields are state. This object-oriented design eliminates the fragmentation across prompt templates, tool schemas, and callback graphs. Echoing this trend on GitHub, **makecindy/cindy** — an open-source do-it-done agent — shot to 711 stars, while **podcast-shorts-factory** demonstrated commercial multi-agent potential with 10 cooperating agents turning long podcasts into short clips, backed by a high fork ratio indicating genuine adoption.

In multimodal and video generation, **SANA-Video 2.0** targets 720p video on a single GPU using hybrid linear attention at 5B/14B scale, maintaining quality while dramatically cutting long-sequence compute costs. **LeAct** introduces a compelling training paradigm: learning to reason from expert system actions (game engines, theorem provers) rather than only outcomes. And **Scaling Agentic RL** from Prime Intellect opens 365,000+ environments for SWE, terminal, and search tasks, removing the data bottleneck for large-scale agentic RL training.
viral_analysis_zh: **AREX**本次最有可能出圈：递归自我改进是AI研究Agent的圣杯命题，141票说明研究社区对「agent如何超越自身」这个话题有极强共鸣。**Claude Opus 5 System Card**排在alphaxiv热榜第一，说明一线工程师对旗舰模型computer use能力进展的高度关注——每次System Card发布都是一次社区集体「对表」的仪式。**Agentic Context Management**则代表了一类天然适合刷屏的工程洞察型论文：不提出新模型，而是将所有人都踩过的坑系统化，配合清晰框架，LinkedIn和Twitter转发率极高。
viral_analysis_en: **AREX** has the strongest viral potential: recursive self-improvement is the holy grail of research agents, and 141 upvotes signals the community's deep resonance with the question of how agents can transcend their own limitations. **Claude Opus 5 System Card** leads the alphaxiv hot feed, reflecting the intense practitioner interest in frontier model computer-use capability — every System Card release becomes a community calibration ritual. **Agentic Context Management** represents a category of engineering-insight papers that are naturally shareable: no new model, just systematic documentation of bugs everyone has hit, packaged with a clean framework, making it ideal for LinkedIn and Twitter amplification.

huggingface_papers.title: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research
huggingface_papers.tldr: AREX introduces a recursively self-improving deep research agent that exploits the discovery-verification asymmetry: rather than just searching longer, it decomposes verification into constraint-wise checks and iteratively refines its current answer, achieving substantial gains over standard search-and-generate baselines.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: AREX提出递归自我改进的深度研究Agent，利用「发现-验证不对称」原理：将验证分解为逐项约束检查，迭代精炼当前答案，相比标准搜索生成基线实现大幅提升。
huggingface_papers.authors: Shuqi Lu, Chaofan Li, Kun Luo

huggingface_papers.title: K12-KGraph: A Curriculum-Aligned Knowledge Graph for Benchmarking and Training Educational LLMs
huggingface_papers.tldr: K12-KGraph constructs a curriculum-aligned knowledge graph covering prerequisite chains, concept taxonomies, and pedagogical sequencing for K-12 education, then uses it as a benchmark to measure 'curriculum cognition' in LLMs — a capability distinct from mere exam QA.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: K12-KGraph构建了K-12教育领域课程对齐知识图谱，涵盖先修关系、概念分类与教学排序，并将「课程认知」能力与单纯考题作答区分开来，作为评测LLM教育能力的新基准。
huggingface_papers.authors: Hao Liang, Qihan Lin, Zhaoyang Han

huggingface_papers.title: SANA-Video 2.0: Hybrid Linear Attention with Attention Residuals for Efficient Video Generation
huggingface_papers.tldr: SANA-Video 2.0 is a 5B/14B hybrid video diffusion transformer that combines linear and full-softmax attention via residual connections, enabling 720p video generation on a single GPU while matching full-softmax quality and retaining favorable long-sequence scaling.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: SANA-Video 2.0是5B/14B规模的混合视频扩散Transformer，通过残差连接融合线性注意力与全softmax注意力，在单卡上实现720p视频生成，质量媲美全softmax模型，同时保留线性注意力的长序列扩展优势。
huggingface_papers.authors: Junsong Chen, Jincheng Yu, Yitong Li

huggingface_papers.title: NVIDIA-labs OO Agents: Native Python Object-Oriented Agents
huggingface_papers.tldr: NOOA (NVIDIA Object-Oriented Agents) reimagines agent development: an agent is a Python object, its methods are actions, and its fields are state. This eliminates the fragmentation across prompt templates, tool schemas, and callback graphs, making agent code more readable, testable, and composable.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: NOOA（NVIDIA面向对象Agent）重新定义Agent开发范式：Agent是Python对象，方法是action，字段是状态。消除了prompt模板、工具schema、回调代码的割裂，使Agent代码更易读、可测试、可组合。
huggingface_papers.authors: Paul Furgale, Severin Klingler, James Nolan

huggingface_papers.title: Tencent WorkBuddy Bench: A Multi-Domain Coding-Agent Benchmark with Contamination-Resistant Task Construction
huggingface_papers.tldr: WorkBuddy Bench is a coding-agent evaluation suite from Tencent spanning Code, Web, Office, and Data domains, featuring contamination-resistant task construction and a cross-model leaderboard. It addresses the benchmark contamination problem by using distribution-informed task generation rather than static test sets.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: WorkBuddy Bench是腾讯推出的多域编程Agent评测套件，覆盖代码、Web、Office和数据四个领域，通过分布感知的任务生成解决基准污染问题，并配有跨模型排行榜。
huggingface_papers.authors: Tencent WorkBuddy Bench Team, Siqi Cai, Shaopeng Chen

alphaxiv_papers.title: Claude Opus 5 System Card
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: Anthropic's System Card for Claude Opus 5 documents gains over Opus 4.8 in agentic coding, computer use, and long-horizon knowledge work, alongside improvements in mathematical and scientific reasoning. It tops the alphaxiv hot feed as practitioners benchmark their agent pipelines against the new frontier.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: Anthropic发布Claude Opus 5 System Card，记录了相比Opus 4.8在agentic编程、computer use和长周期知识工作上的能力提升，以及数学和科学推理方面的进步。作为最新旗舰模型，从业者对此高度关注。

alphaxiv_papers.title: Agentic Context Management: Solving Agent Memory and Cost by Treating Them as Lifecycle and Architecture Problems
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: This paper argues that production agent failures are primarily caused by context collapse — unmanaged conversation history, bloated tool outputs, and growing token costs — rather than reasoning deficiencies. It proposes treating agent memory and cost as lifecycle and architecture design problems, offering concrete system-design patterns.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: 本文指出生产环境Agent失败的根本原因是上下文崩溃——无管理的对话历史、膨胀的工具输出、逐轮递增的token成本，而非推理能力不足。提出将记忆与成本作为生命周期与架构设计问题来系统解决。

alphaxiv_papers.title: LeAct: Learning to Reason from Expert Actions
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: LeAct taps expert systems (game engines, theorem provers, classical planners) as a rich supervision source: rather than learning only from outcomes, models learn to reason by imitating the action sequences that these silent experts produce, without any annotated chain-of-thought.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: LeAct将游戏引擎、定理证明器等专家系统作为监督信号：模型不仅从最终结果学习，而是通过模仿这些系统产生的动作序列来学习推理，无需标注任何推理链。

alphaxiv_papers.title: Scaling Agentic RL: 365,000+ Environments for SWE, Terminal, and Search
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: Prime Intellect releases first-party integrations for 23 agentic tasksets totaling 365,000+ environments covering software engineering, terminal, and search tasks, all accessible behind a single API for both evals and RL training.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: Prime Intellect开放23个agentic任务集的统一API，涵盖365,000+个软件工程、终端和搜索环境，同时支持评测与RL训练，一次性清除agentic RL大规模训练的数据障碍。

alphaxiv_papers.title: OpenForgeRL: Train Harness-native Agents in Any Environment
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: OpenForgeRL addresses the training-inference gap for harness-driven agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.): because open SFT/RL stacks cannot express stateful multi-process harness inference, end-to-end training is blocked. OpenForgeRL closes this gap with a harness-native training framework that works across arbitrary environments.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: OpenForgeRL解决了harness驱动Agent（Claude Code、Codex等）的训练-推理鸿沟：现有开源SFT/RL框架无法表达有状态多进程harness推理，端到端训练被阻断。OpenForgeRL提供harness原生训练框架，支持任意环境。

github_repos.name: Jakubantalik/thinking-orbs
github_repos.tldr: Thinking Orbs provides polished dotted loading indicators designed specifically for AI and agent UIs, giving visual feedback during model thinking or streaming. A focused, immediately usable UI component library that fills a real gap in agent application frontends.
github_repos.tldr_zh: Thinking Orbs为AI和Agent UI提供精致的点状加载指示器，在模型思考或流式输出期间提供视觉反馈。专注于解决Agent应用前端UI体验的即用型组件库。

github_repos.name: makecindy/cindy
github_repos.tldr: Cindy is an open-source AI agent built around the premise 'Consider it done' — it autonomously handles tasks end-to-end after a single instruction. With 711 stars and 84 forks, the strong fork ratio signals genuine real-world adoption beyond star collection.
github_repos.tldr_zh: Cindy是以「说完即做」为核心理念的开源AI Agent，一条指令即可自主完成端到端任务。711星、84 fork的高fork率表明已有大量真实使用，而非仅收藏。

github_repos.name: VictorTaelin/OptMem
github_repos.tldr: OptMem provides permanent memory for AI agents using just a 426-token prompt and a companion script, enabling agents to maintain persistent state across sessions without database infrastructure. Minimal footprint, maximum portability.
github_repos.tldr_zh: OptMem用426 token的prompt加一个脚本为AI Agent实现持久记忆，无需数据库基础设施即可跨会话保持状态。极低占用，最大可移植性。

github_repos.name: krakonjac300-pixel/podcast-shorts-factory
github_repos.tldr: Podcast Shorts Factory orchestrates 10 cooperating AI agents to automatically convert long-form podcasts into short video clips, handling transcription, highlight extraction, and video formatting as a coordinated multi-agent pipeline.
github_repos.tldr_zh: Podcast Shorts Factory编排10个协作AI Agent，自动将长播客转化为短视频，涵盖转录、精华提取和视频格式化，构成完整的多Agent流水线。

github_repos.name: deerwork-ai/deer-workflow
github_repos.tldr: Deer Workflow is an open-source dynamic workflow runtime for AI agents, keeping orchestration logic separate from execution, allowing workflows to adapt at runtime based on agent outputs without re-deploying the entire pipeline.
github_repos.tldr_zh: Deer Workflow是开源动态工作流运行时，将Agent编排逻辑与执行分离，支持工作流在运行时根据Agent输出自适应调整，无需重新部署整个流水线。

hackernews.title: Show HN: Distill and serve models with frontier quality for half the cost
hackernews.tldr: World Model Optimizer enables model distillation targeting frontier-level output quality at roughly half the inference cost, making it practical to deploy high-quality models on budget-constrained infrastructure.
hackernews.tldr_zh: World Model Optimizer提供模型蒸馏方案，以约一半推理成本实现前沿模型质量，使在预算受限基础设施上部署高质量模型成为可能。

hackernews.title: Show HN: Boffin – Staff-engineer layer for AI coding agents
hackernews.tldr: Boffin adds a staff-engineer oversight layer to AI coding agents — reviewing, refining, and gating agent-generated code before it reaches production, addressing the quality and trust gap in fully autonomous coding pipelines.
hackernews.tldr_zh: Boffin为AI编程Agent添加「资深工程师」监督层，在Agent生成的代码进入生产前进行审查、精炼和把关，填补全自动编程流水线的质量与信任缺口。

hackernews.title: Agentic test processes, LLM benchmarks, and other notes on agentic AI coding
hackernews.tldr: Dan Luu's hands-on analysis of agentic AI coding processes covers testing methodologies, benchmark design pitfalls, and practical observations from running LLMs in real coding pipelines — a signal-dense practitioner's note.
hackernews.tldr_zh: Dan Luu对agentic AI编程流程的亲身分析，涵盖测试方法论、基准设计陷阱，以及在真实编程流水线中运行LLM的实践观察，信息密度极高。

hackernews.title: SEC acquiring AI agents to monitor phone locations, social media, and bank records
hackernews.tldr: The SEC is reportedly deploying AI agents for mass surveillance of phone locations, social media, and financial records, raising significant concerns about regulatory overreach and the normalization of autonomous surveillance agents in government institutions.
hackernews.tldr_zh: SEC据报道正在部署AI Agent大规模监控手机位置、社交媒体和银行记录，引发对监管机构滥权和政府机构自主监控Agent常态化的强烈担忧。

hackernews.title: Ask HN: What do you do when your AI agents are working?
hackernews.tldr: A community thread exploring how developers spend their time while AI coding agents run autonomously, touching on the new work patterns, oversight responsibilities, and human-in-the-loop habits emerging in the agentic era.
hackernews.tldr_zh: 社区讨论开发者在AI编程Agent自主运行期间如何利用时间，探索agentic时代涌现出的新工作模式、监督职责和人机协作习惯。
